decisions.summary: FreeGround built once per stage: static surely-taken cells where the site boundary is installed (empty otherwise, stated) plus the placed boxes at the 2 px margin, added as each bundle lands (D7 grid); asked first for every spiral offset and every _slide step (dispersed); on the nucleated path it answers _envelope_blocked placed-box hits in list order and prunes static ground only where the loop judges ground (union envelope; a side box only when the union was refused; a moved box at its moved position); same-seat tests on both paths including the union-clear, side-sample-on-taken-ground case
decisions.why: Both round-2 rulings resolved, checked against the code. (1) The index is now the one FR-003 and the approved analysis name: built once per stage (install_site_boundary runs once, stages.py 130) and updated as each bundle lands through the placed registry index, which follows the Indexed list across the _solve_homestead rebind. Dispersed drops are exact: a house-rect sample point in a surely-taken cell is refused by _site_blocks_rect (the house conjunct of _bundle_common_fits), and a placed-box overlap at the margin is _bundle_side_fits refusal (fit.py 463, strict, +2), both conjuncts of the order-independent _bundle_fits; the slides are covered, since _slide ends on a _bundle_fits NO (place.py 81) and grove_off_field does not touch either conjunct. The no-boundary case is stated: only the placed boxes answer, which is the part that grows with density (the request stated purpose, the city). (2) The nucleated branch now matches place.py 146-174: the union is asked first (a taken sample point makes _union_clear False, exactly as _rect_blocked would), a side box is judged only when the union was refused (line 152), ground-refused returns True before any placed-box move so a static drop never pre-empts a move, and a single placed overlap stays a move with list order kept. The index prunes, the exact test decides. Summary C, research R2 and the Constitution Check now say the same thing.

Household-keying the yard, garden jitter and bed split is implied by the GM's approved words 'the bundle shape built once per size and translated', which cannot hold while each candidate rolls a different shape; the distributions are unchanged and FR-006 guards the result. The condition is met in text: spec.md Decisions Recorded row 2 (Amendment 1), which is itself under re-review - the ruling stands on that row as written. The Summary now cites it as D10.
